column2: She will always cherish the letter her grandfather wrote to her.
column3: 她會永遠珍惜爺爺寫給她的那封信。
column5: cherish 像「切瑞許」：切一顆櫻桃小心捧在手心珍惜

column2: Little birds chirp outside my window every morning at six.
column3: 每天早上六點，小鳥都會在我窗外啾啾叫。
column5: chirp 的聲音就像小鳥在叫「啾啾」，擬聲詞

column2: Cool air circulates through the room when we open both windows.
column3: 我們打開兩扇窗時，涼風就會在房間裡流通。
column5: circ 是圓圈：在圈裡一圈圈地流動

column2: The two toy cars clash in the middle of the track with a loud bang.
column3: 兩輛玩具車在軌道中央砰地撞在一起，發出巨響。
column5: clash 像拍打鈸的聲音「恰」，兩物相撞

column2: Students classify the animals into groups, such as birds and fish.
column3: 學生把動物分成不同組，例如鳥類和魚類。
column5: class 班級：把東西分到不同的班級去

column2: Spies code their messages so that no one else can read them.
column3: 間諜把訊息編成密碼，別人就看不懂。
column5: code 是密碼：把話變成只有你知道的符號

column2: The old bridge may collapse if heavy trucks keep driving over it.
column3: 如果重型卡車持續駛過，那座舊橋可能會倒塌。
column5: col 一起 + lapse 滑落：全部一起滑下來

column2: Do not commit to the trip unless you are sure you can go.
column3: 除非你確定能去，否則不要答應這趟旅行。
column5: com 一起 + mit 送：把自己送進去，不能退出

column2: He likes to compose songs on his guitar after school.
column3: 他放學後喜歡用吉他作曲。
column5: com 一起 + pose 放：把音符放在一起成一首曲

column2: Please concentrate on your homework and turn off the TV for now.
column3: 請專心寫功課，先把電視關掉。
column5: con 一起 + center 中心：心思都集中在中心

column2: We congratulate you on winning the first prize in the singing contest.
column3: 我們恭喜你在歌唱比賽中贏得第一名。
column5: con 一起 + gratul 高興：大家一起為你開心

column2: The climbers worked together to conquer the highest peak in the area.
column3: 登山客合力征服了這一區最高的山峰。
column5: con + quer 尋求：不斷追求，終於拿下

column2: A team consists of five players, and each plays a different role.
column3: 一支隊伍由五名球員組成，每人擔任不同角色。
column5: con 一起 + sist 站：許多東西站在一起構成整體

column2: Workers construct a new bridge over the river this summer.
column3: 今年夏天工人在河上建造一座新橋。
column5: con 一起 + struct 建：把零件一起堆起來蓋好

column2: If you feel sick, consult a doctor before you take any medicine.
column3: 如果你不舒服，吃任何藥前先請教醫生。
column5: con 一起 + sult 問：兩個人坐下來一起商量

column2: Three teams will contest the title of city champion this weekend.
column3: 這個週末有三支隊伍要爭奪全市冠軍的頭銜。
column5: con 一起 + test 見證：大家一起比出高下

column2: The teacher likes to contrast summer with winter to show how seasons differ.
column3: 老師喜歡把夏天和冬天對比，來說明季節有何不同。
column4: contrast A with B (將 A 與 B 對比)
column5: contra 相反 + st 站：站在相反的位置作比較

column2: The students cooperate with each other to finish the science project.
column3: 學生們互相合作，完成科學專題。
column5: co 一起 + operate 操作：大家一起動手做

column2: It is hard to cope with so much homework in just one night.
column3: 一晚就要應付這麼多功課很難。
column5: cope 像「扣破」：事情扣在頭上，也要設法處理好

column2: Mom used a wooden stopper to cork the bottle of homemade juice.
column3: 媽媽用木塞把自製果汁瓶塞住。
column4: cork a bottle (用軟木塞塞住瓶子)
column5: cork 就是軟木塞，用它堵住瓶口

column2: Your answer does not correspond to the facts in the story.
column3: 你的答案和故事裡的事實不符。
column4: correspond to the facts (與事實相符)
column5: cor 一起 + respond 回應：彼此回應得一致

column2: The squirrel can crack a nut with its sharp front teeth.
column3: 松鼠可以用鋒利的門牙把堅果咬開。
column5: crack 就是「喀」的一聲，硬殼被打開

column2: Many students cram the night before the exam, but it is not a good habit.
column3: 很多學生考前一晚死記硬背，但這不是好習慣。
column4: cram for an exam (為考試死記硬背)
column5: cram 像「卡讓」：把東西卡進腦袋硬塞

column2: The storm could cripple the island's power system for several days.
column3: 這場暴風雨可能使島上的供電系統癱瘓好幾天。
column5: cripple 像「克里破」：一破就動不了，失去功能

column2: Please do not criticize your classmates in front of the whole group.
column3: 請不要在全班面前批評你的同學。
column5: critic 是評論家，-ize 讓它變成動作：批評

column2: Be careful not to crush the grapes in your bag.
column3: 小心別把你包包裡的葡萄壓爛。
column5: crush 像「可拉屎」：一壓就爛成一團

column2: Chef Lin will cube the cheese and add it to the salad.
column3: 林主廚會把起司切成小方塊加進沙拉裡。
column4: cube the potatoes (把馬鈴薯切丁)
column5: cube 就是立方體，像骰子，切成一小塊一小塊
column8: 使成立方形；切成小方塊

column2: The director will cue the actor to enter when the music starts.
column3: 音樂一響，導演就會給演員暗示入場。
column5: cue 像「Q」：Q 一下，給你一個暗示

column2: She uses a hot iron to curl her hair before the party.
column3: 她在派對前用熱夾把頭髮燙捲。
column5: curl 像「捲兒」：頭髮捲起來的樣子

column2: In the old tale, the witch would curse the village if no one brought her food.
column3: 在古老的故事裡，如果沒人帶食物給女巫，她就會詛咒村莊。
column5: curse 像「卡死」：被卡住，倒楣的魔法

column2: The road begins to curve to the left near the river.
column3: 道路在河邊開始往左彎。
column5: curve 像「可夫」：拉著線讓它彎成弧形

column2: In the fairy tale, the witch tried to damn the prince to wander forever.
column3: 在童話裡，女巫想詛咒王子永遠流浪。
column4: damn someone to (詛咒某人受苦)
column5: damn 與 dam 水壩同音，被擋住無法前進

column2: The number of visitors will decrease in winter because the weather is cold.
column3: 冬天天氣冷，遊客人數會減少。
column5: de 向下：數字一路往下掉，就是減少

column2: Our school team will defeat the visitors if everyone plays well.
column3: 如果大家都表現好，我們學校的隊伍就會擊敗客隊。
column5: de 不 + feat 功績：讓對手立不了功，就是打敗他

column2: The goalkeeper must defend the net and stop the ball from going in.
column3: 守門員必須守住球門，不讓球進去。
column5: de 離開 + fend 打擊：把攻擊擋開，保護自己

column2: The magician hoped to delight the children with a surprise trick.
column3: 魔術師希望用驚喜的把戲使孩子們開心。
column5: de + light 光：臉上亮了起來，很開心

column2: The train will depart from Platform 3 at nine o'clock.
column3: 火車九點會從三號月台出發。
column4: depart from the station (從車站出發)
column5: de 離開 + part 部分：從原處分開，起程離去

column2: Rainy days can depress people, so many of us listen to cheerful music.
column3: 下雨天會讓人心情低落，所以我們很多人會聽輕快的音樂。
column5: de 向下 + press 壓：心情被往下壓

column2: She decided to devote her weekends to helping at the animal shelter.
column3: 她決定把週末時間奉獻給動物收容所的志工工作。
column5: de + vote 發誓：許下承諾，把心力全給它

column2: Your stomach works hard to digest the food you eat at lunch.
column3: 你的胃很努力地消化你午餐吃的食物。
column5: di 分開 + gest 攜帶：把食物分解送到全身
